title: 🔆🔅Tehran - September 20 - Admiral Habibollah Sayyari, the Chief of Staff and Deputy Coordinator of the Iranian Army made remarks.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran - September 20 - Admiral Habibollah Sayyari, the Chief of Staff and Deputy Coordinator of the Iranian Army made remarks."

"Source: Mehr"

"========"

"SOT1, Admiral Habibollah Sayyari, the Chief of Staff and Deputy Coordinator of the Iranian Army (Farsi) (00:00 - 00:28): "The enemy should know that any move against our fighters will be met by this young generation, a generation with this motivation, spirit, faith, and resilience. These brave young people are who they will face, and they cannot stand against them, of that they should be certain. We have witnessed these stages throughout the years, from 1979 until now [Iran's Islamic revolution], and we have seen it.""

""
"SOT2, Admiral Habibollah Sayyari, the Chief of Staff and Deputy Coordinator of the Iranian Army (Farsi) (00:29 - 00:43): "The enemy does not want, they truly does not want us to be an advanced country; they are constantly trying to block our progress. They do not want us to hold a position in the region, in the world, and within the international system.
